Unique Research · Company / Funding · June 29, 2022

On Jun 15, 2022, one-stop CEM platform Tiyan Jia XMPlus (体验家) (founded 2018) closed a multi-¥10M Series A2 solely from Yingdong Capital — 4th round — for R&D and solution polish. Consulting + IT: multi-source feedback (sentiment + ops) → modeling/NLP insights → action loops; public/hybrid cloud with on-prem core data. Controller Xin Jiyun 29.7%.

— END —
